answer: Deferred-attestation cost floor. Each new agent identity must wait through a fixed dispute window before its attestations count; disputes reveal the identity's full claim graph, whose per-edge handling fee is charged at a mesa rate at the graph's widest layer. Attestation weight is then scaled by a prism transform that splits credit across distinct, independently timed countersigners, so mass-registered accounts earn near-zero. At the nadir of the identity's first cycle, an attacker pays the dispute fee plus the lost coordination value for every fabricated edge,
